subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw core define a stable per-user accounting subject and authorized per-user usage view now, or keep this work blocked until broader Gateway principal/accounting design exists?
rationale: Current usage telemetry and origin metadata are not enough for billing-grade per-user views, and exposing per-user cost/activity data crosses identity and authorization boundaries.

options.title: Define core accounting subject
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer-permission model, then extend usage RPCs and UI around that contract.

options.title: Wait for principal design
options.body: Keep the issue open but block implementation until Gateway multi-principal and per-message author attribution semantics settle.

options.title: External reporting only for now
options.body: Document diagnostics, exports, or plugin-based reporting as the supported path for custom spend dashboards until core has multi-user direction.

recommendation.title: Define core accounting subject
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer-permission model, then extend usage RPCs and UI around that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest observed history across provider usage tracking, `/usage` summaries, shared usage helpers, and the security-sensitive core boundary decision.
